headline: RSI-Prime reports decision-level supervision gains for autonomous model-training agents
summary: A 17 November preprint introduces RSI-Prime, a dataset reported to contain 350 complete model-training trajectories across seven task categories, and decision-level quality annotations for selecting training supervision. On PostTrainBench v1.2, the authors report that full-trajectory SFT raises a GLM-5.3 training agent’s weighted score from 36.56 to 45.61, while decision-level SFT reaches 48.24 and retains 75.48% of supervised tokens. The result is from one harness/model/resource regime, includes disclosed HumanEval content overlap, and has not been independently reproduced here; it does not establish open-ended recursive self-improvement.
